claims.explanation: Ouabain inhibits the Na+/K+-ATPase (ATP1A1), causing ion imbalance and translation inhibition, and cardiac glycosides also block HIF-1α synthesis. Thus, lines with high expression of target pump subunits and dependence on translation/HIF-1 (e.g., EGFR or PTEN mutations, MYC expression) are most sensitive, whereas KRAS mutations and ABCB1-mediated efflux confer resistance.
